about: Golden vectors of fgos dispatch decide and of the PreToolUse dispatch hook, recorded from the Node code that answers them today (scripts/decide-vectors.mjs; evaluator test/helpers/decide-vectors.helper.mjs). A vector is { name, fact, runner?, machine?, args, expect, nativeExpect? }. fact decide: the decision over a loaded runner section (the semantic config check under the label 'vector runner' first, then the default executor layered on and the answer), args the selectors (executorId, for, workId with workHint, assignment with assignmentItem, needsSoul, hasLiveTaskAccess), machine what the tool probe reads as in executor-model.v1.json. fact configRoot: whose config a decide reads over a main checkout and one linked worktree. fact repoRootGuard: --repo-root without --cwd. fact hookPayload: the normalized hook call. fact hookVerdict: the hook's verdict for a call, decide answering args.decided or failing with args.failure. fact hookAnswer: what the hook prints and exits with. expect is the answer, a refusal being { error: { name, code?, message } }. nativeExpect, where present, is the native answer where it differs on purpose (the usage text names fgos dispatch decide, not the retired Node alias). The rules of the semantic config check itself are proven by the validate vectors of executor-model.v1.json and are not repeated here.
